query:
-- Deduplicated exclusion list
SELECT email, MIN(name) as name, MIN(kidName) as kidName, reason FROM (
  SELECT cr.email, CONCAT(cr.parentFirstName, ' ', cr.parentLastName) as name, cr.camper1Name as kidName, 'Already enrolled in camp' as reason
  FROM campRegistrations cr WHERE cr.email IS NOT NULL AND cr.email != ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT l.email, l.parentName, l.kidName, 'Already received nurture emails' as reason
  FROM leads l
  INNER JOIN leadSequenceQueue lsq ON lsq.leadId = l.id
  WHERE lsq.sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
    AND lsq.status = 'sent'
    AND l.email IS NOT NULL AND l.email != ''
) combined
GROUP BY email, reason
ORDER BY reason, name;
